notes: A complete overhaul delivering faster playback, a lighter footprint, and a smoother experience than ever before.

Important: Manual update required - Due to significant architectural changes, please download the latest Setup and reinstall, or extract the Portable/Update ZIP to the app root. Your settings, playlists, and library will be preserved. Future updates can use the in-app updater again.
Native Playback - Albums now play through a native playback engine instead of embedding Bandcamp's page player. Enjoy faster startup, reduced memory usage, and a much more responsive experience.

Lightweight Bandcamp Integration - WebEngine is now reserved exclusively for Bandcamp sign-in. Wishlist, follow, and account-state operations use lightweight HTTP requests with a Windows session file.
Silky-Smooth Loading Spinner - A dedicated spinner process keeps animations fluid during startup, URL loading, shutdown, and Settings theme application, even when the main UI is busy.

Album Themes from Cover Art - Album themes now generate colours directly from the cover art, bypassing Bandcamp's increasingly restrictive page-palette extraction. Includes Dark and Light adaptation options.
UI & Design Refresh - Refined controls, clearer now-playing rows, softer styling, an improved progress knob, and updated album-themed window chrome.
Quality of Life - Improved startup and shutdown, streamlined Advanced settings, and various refinements to login/logout handling and loading overlays.
Thanks - Special thanks to everyone who tested early builds, reported bugs, and provided feedback throughout development. Your contributions helped make this release possible!
